question: Simplify {{3294}over{(226+506) of {3over4}}}+500
solution:
**Concept Used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63e3fd54db77dff5e0d64f39578116d3ccc79809bfa961f0716ef633bf7ad2d4.png] 

**Calculation:**

**⇒ {{3294}over{(226+506) of {3over4}}}+500**

**⇒ {{3294}over{732 times {3over4}}}+500**

⇒ (3294)/(549)+500=6+500=506

**Hence, the simplified value of the expression is 506**
